name: Article 2 – § 1 – point 1; Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 – Article 14a – after § 3 – 125
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 1272/2008, (EC) No 1223/2009 and (EU) 2019/1009 as regards simplification of certain requirements and procedures for chemical products
part_text: 3a. Where the SCCS concludes that a substance is safe for the requested use, the Commission shall, within three months of receiving the opinion referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article, initiate the procedure for including the substance in the relevant Annex in accordance with Article 31(2), unless it communicates to the applicant, within the same period, a duly reasoned decision not to initiate that procedure.
